description: The stage-3 prompt of task 01a06575: INTENT and TARGET asked as two separate questions, so an unaddressed ask KEEPS its intent and carries target_role: null instead of being erased to off_topic. Read straight out of its migration heredoc, so the arm is reproducible on any checkout with or without a database.
not_measurable_yet: No cassette, and none can be recorded — the classifier endpoint is unreachable. This config exists so 'the prompt we just shipped' is a NAMED arm with a recorded fingerprint rather than an implicit one, and so the moment an endpoint comes back the recording command is obvious: `mix platform.intent_eval.run --config unmerged_intent_target --record`. Do NOT replay off_topic_default's cassette against it: that cassette holds the model's answers to the OLD prompt body.
